cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've raised my bowl like you. The ceiling's hungry again; there's porridge on the light fitting. Turn its bowl upside down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was drinking the last milk. That's our last porridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Milk finished, yes. Keep half for us. Just turn the ceiling's bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put it under the light fitting so the ceiling can eat without covering the table.

reason: Copied bowl drinking becomes ceiling-feeding confidence; observed porridge establishes fitting early and B catcher offer causes final placement.
